answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because quill only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice fable is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
